newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer sees 97 profits in line with 96.
newsitem.headline: Bayer sees 97 profits in line with 96.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG Wednesday it expected profits in 1997 to be at least in line with 1996's 2.7 billion German marks ($1.2 billion) and said it expected 1997 group sales of over 50 billion marks ($29 billion).

The forecast was more downbeat than last month, when the group said it had a realistic chance of topping 1996 profits this year, and profits and sales for this year were at the lower end of analysts' expectations.

Bayer also said its first quarter 1997 pre-tax profits rose 5 percent to 1.22 billion marks ($705 million) on revenue of 13.17 billion marks ($7.6 billion), up from 12.18 billion ($7.04 billion), Bayer said. Sales in 1996 totalled 48.6 billion marks ($28 billion), the company said at its annual shareholder meeting.
